0022600032.text: The Lakers (6-2, on a two-game winning streak and 1st in the Pacific) host the Portland Trail Blazers (5-1, on a two-game winning streak and 1st in the Northwest) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with Los Angeles at 4-1 at home and Portland at 4-0 on the road. Adou Thiero is out for the Lakers with knee inflammation, while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The Lakers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 136-129 at home, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-2.
